name: Retaliation
body:
Having begun to see the automatons as friends and allies, you whip up into a rage when you see one fall.

Prerequisites: Honorary Tinker

Benefit: Whenever a creature reduces an automaton to 0 hp, it provokes an attack of opportunity from you.

The Tinker: Master of Modular Mechanical Mayhem, Copyright 2013 Bradley Arthur Crouch.
